context.transcript:
I'll be conducting a refresher training for all certified forklift
operators in the warehouse next week, but I need to make
you aware of a few things now. It's come to my attention
that only the crew working the morning shift has been
completing the forklift inspection checklist. However,
the forklifts must be inspected at the beginning of every
eight-hour shift. That's three times a day. Also, if you notice
anything that isn't functioning properly, please don't forget to
document it. We have a logbook on the wall over there for
this purpose.
context.transcript_translation: 下周，我将为仓库内所有持证的叉车操作员进行复训，不过有几件事我现在就需要提醒大家。我注意到，目前只有早班员工完成了叉车检查清单。然而，每个八小时班次开始时都必须检查叉车，也就是每天三次。另外，如果你发现任何设备功能异常，请不要忘记记录。那边墙上挂着一本日志，专门用来记录这些问题。
context.content_translation: 本段听力围绕“仓储安全说明”展开。请先听清人物关系和对话目的，再抓取时间、地点、原因、行动等关键信息。
